name: Bashal'Aran
summary: Perched upon a bluff in the overrun ruins of Bashal'Aran, an unearthly blue aura repels the demonic satyrs and vicious grells that infest the ancient night elven city. The Sentinel scout Thundris Windweaver sends adventurers to investigate the source of this untouched sanctuary. Reaching the site reveals the lingering spirit of Asterion, an ancient highborne presence yearning for civil company.

sections.title: A Beacon in the Ruins
sections.body: Bashal'Aran once stood as a glorious settlement of the ancient Kaldorei Empire, but its broken marble and overgrown arches now teem with demonic taint. Twisted satyrs and corrupt grells feed greedily upon the lingering magical energies of the ruins, their malice swelling with every passing day. Yet despite their predatory dominion, Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine spotted a curious curiosity: atop a western bluff in the ruins, an ethereal blue aura burns pure, keeping every demon and sprite at bay.

sections.title: The Wounded Shade
sections.body: Braving the demonic patrols to reach the elevated shrine reveals that the warding light is no natural phenomenon. It emanates from Asterion, an ancient spirit whose vigil has persisted through centuries of solitude. Surrounded by howling beasts and vile fiends, the weary shade views even a traveling stranger as a welcome respite from decades of isolation.

faq.q: Where is the blue aura located?
faq.answer: The blue aura shines atop a small raised bluff on the western edge of the ruins of Bashal'Aran, just east of Auberdine in Darkshore. It sits slightly elevated above the surrounding crumbling walls.

faq.q: Why do the satyrs avoid the shrine?
faq.answer: The shrine is protected by a warding blue aura projected by the ancient spirit Asterion, whose lingering magic repels the demonic satyrs and corrupt grells that otherwise infest the ruins.

faq.q: Who sends you on this quest?
faq.answer: Thundris Windweaver, an elven scout stationed in Auberdine, provides the quest after observing the unnatural demonic movements within the eastern ruins.

Asterion is an ancient night elf shade bound to a shrine in Bashal'Aran. Long separated from civilized society, he endures surrounded by hostile demonic beasts while maintaining the site's protective barrier.

Bashal'Aran is an ancient kaldorei ruin nestled in the forests of Darkshore. Sacked during the ancient Sundering, it has become infested with magical parasites, grells, and satyrs seeking to feast on its dormant ley powers.
Yes. Upon speaking to Asterion, he enlists your help to strike back against the surrounding satyrs and grells to aid his lingering spirit.

angles.text: Bashal'Aran is a somber reminder of what was lost during the Sundering, where your ancient kin's lingering shades still hold lonely vigils against encroaching demonic corruption.
Auberdine's scouts rely on Alliance wanderers to push into Darkshore's contested ruins and neutralize demonic threats before they reach the coast.
